name: Mathematics, Linear Algebra & Optimization
description: Mathematical foundations for machine learning: linear algebra, multivariable calculus, gradients, Jacobians/Hessians, probability distributions, Bayesian inference, and optimization algorithms.

subskills.name: Linear Algebra & Matrix Decompositions
subskills.description: Vectors, matrices, dot products, eigenvalues, eigenvectors, Singular Value Decomposition (SVD), QR decomposition, and matrix rank.

subskills.name: Multivariate Calculus, Gradients & Jacobians
subskills.description: Partial derivatives, chain rule in multivariate calculus, gradient vectors, Jacobian matrices, Hessian matrices, and Taylor approximations.

subskills.name: Probability Distributions & Bayesian Inference
subskills.description: Gaussian/Normal, Bernoulli, Poisson, Exponential distributions, Bayes theorem, prior/posterior/likelihood, and Maximum A Posteriori (MAP).

subskills.name: Maximum Likelihood Estimation (MLE)
subskills.description: Log-likelihood formulation, finding optimal parameter estimators analytically and numerically, and relationship to cross-entropy loss.

subskills.name: First-Order Optimization (GD, SGD, Momentum, Adam)
subskills.description: Batch Gradient Descent, Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD), Mini-batch GD, Momentum, RMSprop, Adam, AdamW, and learning rate dynamics.

subskills.name: Second-Order & Constrained Optimization
subskills.description: Newton-Raphson, quasi-Newton (BFGS / L-BFGS), Lagrange multipliers, KKT conditions, and primal-dual optimization.

subskills.name: Information Theory, Entropy & KL Divergence
subskills.description: Shannon entropy, joint entropy, conditional entropy, mutual information, cross-entropy, and Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence.

subskills.name: Statistical Hypothesis Testing & A/B Testing Math
subskills.description: Null/alternative hypothesis, p-values, z-test, t-test, ANOVA, Chi-Square test, Type I / Type II errors, and power analysis.

subskills.name: Loss Functions & Convexity Analysis
subskills.description: MSE, MAE, Huber loss, Hinge loss, Focal loss, Triplet loss, Bregman divergences, and verifying objective function convexity.

cv.signal: Designed custom loss functions and derived analytical optimization solutions for ML models

linkedin.signal: Endorsed for Machine Learning Mathematics, Linear Algebra, and Statistics

assessment.signal: Passes ML Mathematics, Linear Algebra & Optimization Assessment

junior.description: Understands matrix algebra, computes partial gradients using chain rule, and works with standard probability distributions.

mid.description: Formulates MLE problems, tunes first-order optimizers (Adam/SGD), runs statistical hypothesis tests, and selects appropriate loss functions.

senior.description: Applies second-order optimization and quasi-Newton methods, analyzes information-theoretic KL divergence, and proves algorithmic convexity.
